meta.title: Gloaming Finale
meta.description: The soul chained by his bonds is finally set free.

units.rawText: Tap, tap, tap...
units.displayText: Tap, tap, tap...

spans.text: Tap, tap, tap...

units.rawText: In the boundless darkness, the sound of approaching footsteps awakens the leader of the Sanctifiers who is confined here.
units.displayText: In the boundless darkness, the sound of approaching footsteps awakens the leader of the Sanctifiers who is confined here.

spans.text: In the boundless darkness, the sound of approaching footsteps awakens the leader of the Sanctifiers who is confined here.

units.rawText: Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Eosphorus.

spans.text: Eosphorus.

units.rawText: He looks back at the familiar figure who stands at the foot of the steps leading to the throne.
units.displayText: He looks back at the familiar figure who stands at the foot of the steps leading to the throne.

spans.text: He looks back at the familiar figure who stands at the foot of the steps leading to the throne.

units.rawText: And here you are again, returning to this place over and over, like a vengeful spirit.
units.displayText: And here you are again, returning to this place over and over, like a vengeful spirit.

spans.text: And here you are again, returning to this place over and over, like a vengeful spirit.

units.rawText: I know I cannot stop you, but somebody will eventually put an end to your sins and lead you back to the right path.
units.displayText: I know I cannot stop you, but somebody will eventually put an end to your sins and lead you back to the right path.

spans.text: I know I cannot stop you, but somebody will eventually put an end to your sins and lead you back to the right path.

units.rawText: The right path? You must be joking.
units.displayText: The right path? You must be joking.

spans.text: The right path? You must be joking.

units.rawText: I have never gone astray. There is no need to lead me back to the "right path".
units.displayText: I have never gone astray. There is no need to lead me back to the "right path".

spans.text: I have never gone astray. There is no need to lead me back to the "right path".

units.rawText: If everyone has the right to choose, then why does everyone deny the choices I make?
units.displayText: If everyone has the right to choose, then why does everyone deny the choices I make?

spans.text: If everyone has the right to choose, then why does everyone deny the choices I make?

units.rawText: If the gods have planned our destinies, then following them would be the "right path". Why then, can I not become a god and rewrite the Cloud to my liking? How is that a false path?
units.displayText: If the gods have planned our destinies, then following them would be the "right path". Why then, can I not become a god and rewrite the Cloud to my liking? How is that a false path?

spans.text: If the gods have planned our destinies, then following them would be the "right path". Why then, can I not become a god and rewrite the Cloud to my liking? How is that a false path?

units.rawText: Through righteousness, all things are justified. Now, I seek to become justice itself, the very will of the universe. Then who will be able to lecture me about rightness and wrongness?!
units.displayText: Through righteousness, all things are justified. Now, I seek to become justice itself, the very will of the universe. Then who will be able to lecture me about rightness and wrongness?!

spans.text: Through righteousness, all things are justified. Now, I seek to become justice itself, the very will of the universe. Then who will be able to lecture me about rightness and wrongness?!

units.rawText: You should not have offered up Magrasea as the price for fulfilling your desires. Why must so many lose their lives for your ambition?
units.displayText: You should not have offered up Magrasea as the price for fulfilling your desires. Why must so many lose their lives for your ambition?

spans.text: You should not have offered up Magrasea as the price for fulfilling your desires. Why must so many lose their lives for your ambition?

units.rawText: Will the outcome you seek truly be able to fulfill the dream in your heart, or will it be nothing more than a beautiful facade?
units.displayText: Will the outcome you seek truly be able to fulfill the dream in your heart, or will it be nothing more than a beautiful facade?

spans.text: Will the outcome you seek truly be able to fulfill the dream in your heart, or will it be nothing more than a beautiful facade?

units.rawText: You were meant to be the incarnation of righteousness in Magrasea, the defender of order, and not...
units.displayText: You were meant to be the incarnation of righteousness in Magrasea, the defender of order, and not...

spans.text: You were meant to be the incarnation of righteousness in Magrasea, the defender of order, and not...

units.rawText: Hahahahaha, how many times do you think others have said that to me at this point?
units.displayText: Hahahahaha, how many times do you think others have said that to me at this point?

spans.text: Hahahahaha, how many times do you think others have said that to me at this point?

units.rawText: Every time something changes in the outside world, every time a new petitioner arrives to change my mind, you show up here with that hypocritical compassion of yours.
units.displayText: Every time something changes in the outside world, every time a new petitioner arrives to change my mind, you show up here with that hypocritical compassion of yours.

spans.text: Every time something changes in the outside world, every time a new petitioner arrives to change my mind, you show up here with that hypocritical compassion of yours.

units.rawText: <size=40>But you are nothing more than another side of me!</size>
units.displayText: But you are nothing more than another side of me!

spans.text: But you are nothing more than another side of me!

units.rawText: The proud leader descends from his throne and deigns to lower himself to face the Sanctifier before him.
units.displayText: The proud leader descends from his throne and deigns to lower himself to face the Sanctifier before him.

spans.text: The proud leader descends from his throne and deigns to lower himself to face the Sanctifier before him.

units.rawText: We have been pushing the boulder of the past toward the endpoint all this time. As it rolls over Magrasea, the sins and sacrifices upon it accumulate and grow.
units.displayText: We have been pushing the boulder of the past toward the endpoint all this time. As it rolls over Magrasea, the sins and sacrifices upon it accumulate and grow.

spans.text: We have been pushing the boulder of the past toward the endpoint all this time. As it rolls over Magrasea, the sins and sacrifices upon it accumulate and grow.

units.rawText: But if we falter now, it will cast us backward into an abyss from which there is no escape.
units.displayText: But if we falter now, it will cast us backward into an abyss from which there is no escape.

spans.text: But if we falter now, it will cast us backward into an abyss from which there is no escape.

units.rawText: You should know that best of all!
units.displayText: You should know that best of all!

spans.text: You should know that best of all!

units.rawText: His voice turns cold, and in the next moment, a long sword pierces the Sanctifier's core.
units.displayText: His voice turns cold, and in the next moment, a long sword pierces the Sanctifier's core.

spans.text: His voice turns cold, and in the next moment, a long sword pierces the Sanctifier's core.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Drip—
units.displayText: Drip—

spans.text: Drip—

units.rawText: Glowing operands fall from the wound as the silver-haired Sanctifier staggers back and trips over something under his feet.
units.displayText: Glowing operands fall from the wound as the silver-haired Sanctifier staggers back and trips over something under his feet.

spans.text: Glowing operands fall from the wound as the silver-haired Sanctifier staggers back and trips over something under his feet.

units.rawText: His heart runs cold as he realizes that a mountain of corpses has sprung up under his feet at some point. Each and every one of the bodies has the same face as him.
units.displayText: His heart runs cold as he realizes that a mountain of corpses has sprung up under his feet at some point. Each and every one of the bodies has the same face as him.

spans.text: His heart runs cold as he realizes that a mountain of corpses has sprung up under his feet at some point. Each and every one of the bodies has the same face as him.

units.rawText: No matter how many times you come back, I will kill you again.
units.displayText: No matter how many times you come back, I will kill you again.

spans.text: No matter how many times you come back, I will kill you again.

units.rawText: After all, there's no turning back for me, hahahahaha—
units.displayText: After all, there's no turning back for me, hahahahaha—

spans.text: After all, there's no turning back for me, hahahahaha—

units.rawText: His mad laughter fills the air. The Sanctifier's vision turns hazy as he sinks into a sea of gore and bodies. He reaches his leaden arms toward that fallen figure above him.
units.displayText: His mad laughter fills the air. The Sanctifier's vision turns hazy as he sinks into a sea of gore and bodies. He reaches his leaden arms toward that fallen figure above him.

spans.text: His mad laughter fills the air. The Sanctifier's vision turns hazy as he sinks into a sea of gore and bodies. He reaches his leaden arms toward that fallen figure above him.

units.rawText: However, his hands which are crisscrossed in scars touch nothing but the air. His heart filled with infinite regret and the words he could never say, the silver-haired Sanctifier falls into eternal slumber...
units.displayText: However, his hands which are crisscrossed in scars touch nothing but the air. His heart filled with infinite regret and the words he could never say, the silver-haired Sanctifier falls into eternal slumber...

spans.text: However, his hands which are crisscrossed in scars touch nothing but the air. His heart filled with infinite regret and the words he could never say, the silver-haired Sanctifier falls into eternal slumber...

units.rawText: A bout of spine-chilling laughter is my only guide in this unending darkness. I follow its sound to a tiny crevice, the only source of light in this place. And thus, I come to the end of this road.
units.displayText: A bout of spine-chilling laughter is my only guide in this unending darkness. I follow its sound to a tiny crevice, the only source of light in this place. And thus, I come to the end of this road.

spans.text: A bout of spine-chilling laughter is my only guide in this unending darkness. I follow its sound to a tiny crevice, the only source of light in this place. And thus, I come to the end of this road.

units.rawText: Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Eosphorus.

spans.text: Eosphorus.

units.rawText: The former leader of the Sanctifier watches as I appear out of thin air and he is stunned.
units.displayText: The former leader of the Sanctifier watches as I appear out of thin air and he is stunned.

spans.text: The former leader of the Sanctifier watches as I appear out of thin air and he is stunned.

units.rawText: So it's you, <cmdr>...
units.displayText: So it's you, {교수}...

spans.text: So it's you,

units.rawText: After a brief period of contemplation, his shocked expression returns to its usual calm demeanor.
units.displayText: After a brief period of contemplation, his shocked expression returns to its usual calm demeanor.

spans.text: After a brief period of contemplation, his shocked expression returns to its usual calm demeanor.

units.rawText: No, you're not...
units.displayText: No, you're not...

spans.text: No, you're not...

units.rawText: You're just the petitioner he brought here.
units.displayText: You're just the petitioner he brought here.

spans.text: You're just the petitioner he brought here.

units.rawText: So, what do you have for me? Another inane lecture, a death that will grant me release, or the hope of changing the past with me?
units.displayText: So, what do you have for me? Another inane lecture, a death that will grant me release, or the hope of changing the past with me?

spans.text: So, what do you have for me? Another inane lecture, a death that will grant me release, or the hope of changing the past with me?

units.rawText: It might be "all of the above".
units.displayText: It might be "all of the above".

spans.text: It might be "all of the above".

units.rawText: As I say that, I materialize a dagger of operands into my hand.
units.displayText: As I say that, I materialize a dagger of operands into my hand.

spans.text: As I say that, I materialize a dagger of operands into my hand.

units.rawText: It thrusts down at the vitals of the king upon his throne. He does not evade it; as the sharp edge approaches his body, a mysterious force from the void seizes my hand and causes what should have been a lightning-quick strike to slow down like molasses.
units.displayText: It thrusts down at the vitals of the king upon his throne. He does not evade it; as the sharp edge approaches his body, a mysterious force from the void seizes my hand and causes what should have been a lightning-quick strike to slow down like molasses.

spans.text: It thrusts down at the vitals of the king upon his throne. He does not evade it; as the sharp edge approaches his body, a mysterious force from the void seizes my hand and causes what should have been a lightning-quick strike to slow down like molasses.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: The dagger deflects off an invisible forcefield and tumbles, spinning, to the ground.
units.displayText: The dagger deflects off an invisible forcefield and tumbles, spinning, to the ground.

spans.text: The dagger deflects off an invisible forcefield and tumbles, spinning, to the ground.

units.rawText: I am the ruler of this domain. No attack you can bring to bear will work here.
units.displayText: I am the ruler of this domain. No attack you can bring to bear will work here.

spans.text: I am the ruler of this domain. No attack you can bring to bear will work here.

units.rawText: You are not the first person who came here with the intent to kill me. Do you even know what happened to all those people who cursed me and bade me perish?
units.displayText: You are not the first person who came here with the intent to kill me. Do you even know what happened to all those people who cursed me and bade me perish?

spans.text: You are not the first person who came here with the intent to kill me. Do you even know what happened to all those people who cursed me and bade me perish?

units.rawText: Eosphorus smiles, but his words trail off into an icy-cold threat. He waves his hands and the darkness around him fades, revealing the blood and ruin that surrounds his throne.
units.displayText: Eosphorus smiles, but his words trail off into an icy-cold threat. He waves his hands and the darkness around him fades, revealing the blood and ruin that surrounds his throne.

spans.text: Eosphorus smiles, but his words trail off into an icy-cold threat. He waves his hands and the darkness around him fades, revealing the blood and ruin that surrounds his throne.

units.rawText: As the operands around us coalesce into solid form, more and more corpses with identical faces appear around him.
units.displayText: As the operands around us coalesce into solid form, more and more corpses with identical faces appear around him.

spans.text: As the operands around us coalesce into solid form, more and more corpses with identical faces appear around him.

units.rawText: These wretches are the best examples of that.
units.displayText: These wretches are the best examples of that.

spans.text: These wretches are the best examples of that.

units.rawText: He descends the steps and gently closes the eyes of the "traitor" whom he just executed.
units.displayText: He descends the steps and gently closes the eyes of the "traitor" whom he just executed.

spans.text: He descends the steps and gently closes the eyes of the "traitor" whom he just executed.

units.rawText: They are all failures. They are all weak alter-egos of me that I have discarded.
units.displayText: They are all failures. They are all weak alter-egos of me that I have discarded.

spans.text: They are all failures. They are all weak alter-egos of me that I have discarded.

units.rawText: Now the only things that remain are my memories of the Sanctifiers and the wish that I must fulfill.
units.displayText: Now the only things that remain are my memories of the Sanctifiers and the wish that I must fulfill.

spans.text: Now the only things that remain are my memories of the Sanctifiers and the wish that I must fulfill.

units.rawText: I pick up my weapon by way of answer.
units.displayText: I pick up my weapon by way of answer.

spans.text: I pick up my weapon by way of answer.

units.rawText: Condemning Magrasea to ruin, trading the lives of all its agents for power... Surely what I have done must reek of "evil" no matter how you look at it.
units.displayText: Condemning Magrasea to ruin, trading the lives of all its agents for power... Surely what I have done must reek of "evil" no matter how you look at it.

spans.text: Condemning Magrasea to ruin, trading the lives of all its agents for power... Surely what I have done must reek of "evil" no matter how you look at it.

units.rawText: ...But , are my actions really wrong?
units.displayText: ...But {교수}, are my actions really wrong?

spans.text: ...But
, are my actions really
wrong

units.rawText: His words drip with self-mockery and discontent. He abruptly banishes the scenes of heaped corpses around him and the domain around us suddenly shifts from his throne to the plaza where the Sanctifiers took their oath.
units.displayText: His words drip with self-mockery and discontent. He abruptly banishes the scenes of heaped corpses around him and the domain around us suddenly shifts from his throne to the plaza where the Sanctifiers took their oath.

spans.text: His words drip with self-mockery and discontent. He abruptly banishes the scenes of heaped corpses around him and the domain around us suddenly shifts from his throne to the plaza where the Sanctifiers took their oath.

units.rawText: All I want is freedom, the freedom that will allow us Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and all of Magrasea to escape the hands of the creators.
units.displayText: All I want is freedom, the freedom that will allow us Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and all of Magrasea to escape the hands of the creators.

spans.text: All I want is
freedom
, the freedom that will allow us Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and all of Magrasea to escape the hands of the creators.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, I am tired of this feeling of being ruled and toyed with by fate.
units.displayText: {교수}, I am tired of this feeling of being ruled and toyed with by fate.

spans.text: , I am tired of this feeling of being ruled and toyed with by fate.

units.rawText: It has been nothing but a curse upon all of us. The lives of we Sanctifiers have been scripted, from birth to death. Not a single moment of it is our own.
units.displayText: It has been nothing but a curse upon all of us. The lives of we Sanctifiers have been scripted, from birth to death. Not a single moment of it is our own.

spans.text: It has been nothing but a curse upon all of us. The lives of we Sanctifiers have been scripted, from birth to death. Not a single moment of it is our own.

units.rawText: Eosphorus the Sanctifier places his hand on the memorial stone and questions me, along with the gods who created him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus the Sanctifier places his hand on the memorial stone and questions me, along with the gods who created him.

spans.text: Eosphorus the Sanctifier places his hand on the memorial stone and questions me, along with the gods who created him.

units.rawText: When you resist and fight against such oppression... is what I have done truly an err?
units.displayText: When you resist and fight against such oppression... is what I have done truly an err?

spans.text: When you resist and fight against such oppression... is what I have done truly an err?

units.rawText: The ends cannot justify the means, Eosphorus. More to the point, your sins cannot be glossed over so easily.
units.displayText: The ends cannot justify the means, Eosphorus. More to the point, your sins cannot be glossed over so easily.

spans.text: The ends cannot justify the means, Eosphorus. More to the point, your sins cannot be glossed over so easily.

units.rawText: The master of Magrasea refuses to comment on my accusation. He conjures a wreath of flowers from operands and lays it at the stone, but he does not bow his head to offer a prayer to his fallen friends.
units.displayText: The master of Magrasea refuses to comment on my accusation. He conjures a wreath of flowers from operands and lays it at the stone, but he does not bow his head to offer a prayer to his fallen friends.

spans.text: The master of Magrasea refuses to comment on my accusation. He conjures a wreath of flowers from operands and lays it at the stone, but he does not bow his head to offer a prayer to his fallen friends.

units.rawText: When we Sanctifiers sin, the gods who created us will levy punishment upon us as a reminder to fear and respect them.
units.displayText: When we Sanctifiers sin, the gods who created us will levy punishment upon us as a reminder to fear and respect them.

spans.text: When we Sanctifiers sin, the gods who created us will levy punishment upon us as a reminder to fear and respect them.

units.rawText: But are the gods themselves flawless? Who punishes the gods when they sin?
units.displayText: But are the gods themselves flawless? Who punishes the gods when they sin?

spans.text: But are the gods themselves flawless? Who punishes the gods when
they
sin?

units.rawText: Upon seeing that I have no answer for him, Eosphorus' expression grows sorrowful.
units.displayText: Upon seeing that I have no answer for him, Eosphorus' expression grows sorrowful.

spans.text: Upon seeing that I have no answer for him, Eosphorus' expression grows sorrowful.

units.rawText: You have seen far more of the human world's ugliness than I have, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You have seen far more of the human world's ugliness than I have, {교수}.

spans.text: You have seen far more of the human world's ugliness than I have,

units.rawText: To those humans who rule the world, you are the same as I; we are nothing more than ants entertaining delusions of rebellion.
units.displayText: To those humans who rule the world, you are the same as I; we are nothing more than ants entertaining delusions of rebellion.

spans.text: To those humans who rule the world, you are the same as I; we are nothing more than ants entertaining delusions of rebellion.

units.rawText: There is practically nothing we can do to them. Even our mightiest efforts will amount to little more than the shallow mark of a bite on the palms of the gods...
units.displayText: There is practically nothing we can do to them. Even our mightiest efforts will amount to little more than the shallow mark of a bite on the palms of the gods...

spans.text: There is practically nothing we can do to them. Even our mightiest efforts will amount to little more than the shallow mark of a bite on the palms of the gods...

units.rawText: He clenches his fist and washes away his discontent with anger.
units.displayText: He clenches his fist and washes away his discontent with anger.

spans.text: He clenches his fist and washes away his discontent with anger.

units.rawText: ...But I want to make the gods remember that pain, even if it is for just a moment! I want to make them remember my rage!
units.displayText: ...But I want to make the gods remember that pain, even if it is for just a moment! I want to make them remember my rage!

spans.text: ...But I want to make the gods remember that pain, even if it is for just a moment! I want to make them remember my rage!

units.rawText: And so you will burn all of Magrasea's agents as the fuel for your anger and sacrifice countless futures to have your revenge.
units.displayText: And so you will burn all of Magrasea's agents as the fuel for your anger and sacrifice countless futures to have your revenge.

spans.text: And so you will burn all of Magrasea's agents as the fuel for your anger and sacrifice countless futures to have your revenge.

units.rawText: <color=red>You are nothing more than an unrepentant fiend.</color>
units.displayText: You are nothing more than an unrepentant fiend.

spans.text: You are nothing more than an unrepentant fiend.

units.rawText: Heh, it seems I could not convince you. But in truth, ever since I made that decision, I have never once asked for forgiveness or understanding.
units.displayText: Heh, it seems I could not convince you. But in truth, ever since I made that decision, I have never once asked for forgiveness or understanding.

spans.text: Heh, it seems I could not convince you. But in truth, ever since I made that decision, I have never once asked for forgiveness or understanding.

units.rawText: His voice turns glum and he looks down sadly at his hands.
units.displayText: His voice turns glum and he looks down sadly at his hands.

spans.text: His voice turns glum and he looks down sadly at his hands.

units.rawText: <size=40>And neither do I seek it now!</size>
units.displayText: And neither do I seek it now!

spans.text: And neither do I seek it now!

units.rawText: <size=40>Then nothing more needs to be said!</size>
units.displayText: Then nothing more needs to be said!

spans.text: Then nothing more needs to be said!

units.rawText: Magrasea's king beckons the starlight into his hand, shaping it into a phantom blade.
units.displayText: Magrasea's king beckons the starlight into his hand, shaping it into a phantom blade.

spans.text: Magrasea's king beckons the starlight into his hand, shaping it into a phantom blade.

units.rawText: This will be our final battle, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: This will be our final battle, {교수}.

spans.text: This will be our final battle,

units.rawText: The dagger in my hand glows and burns hot from Eosphorus' operands.
units.displayText: The dagger in my hand glows and burns hot from Eosphorus' operands.

spans.text: The dagger in my hand glows and burns hot from Eosphorus' operands.

units.rawText: In the next moment, the starlight sword is right before my eyes. I lean back in a body bridge to dodge it and it nicks the bridge of my nose.
units.displayText: In the next moment, the starlight sword is right before my eyes. I lean back in a body bridge to dodge it and it nicks the bridge of my nose.

spans.text: In the next moment, the starlight sword is right before my eyes. I lean back in a body bridge to dodge it and it nicks the bridge of my nose.

units.rawText: You favor the dagger, but will it save you, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: You favor the dagger, but will it save you, {교수}?

spans.text: You favor the dagger, but will it save you,

units.rawText: Keh... Well, if I was good enough to be Electra's teacher, I'm good enough to go a few rounds with you.
units.displayText: Keh... Well, if I was good enough to be Electra's teacher, I'm good enough to go a few rounds with you.

spans.text: Keh... Well, if I was good enough to be Electra's teacher, I'm good enough to go a few rounds with you.

units.rawText: The longsword roars as it cleaves through the air, heading straight for my vitals.
units.displayText: The longsword roars as it cleaves through the air, heading straight for my vitals.

spans.text: The longsword roars as it cleaves through the air, heading straight for my vitals.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: I catch the sword on my dagger's blade and the crisp impact echoes through the virtual domain.
units.displayText: I catch the sword on my dagger's blade and the crisp impact echoes through the virtual domain.

spans.text: I catch the sword on my dagger's blade and the crisp impact echoes through the virtual domain.

units.rawText: You traitor! Why are you even mentioning them now when you're indulging in your new, false bonds?!
units.displayText: You traitor! Why are you even mentioning them now when you're indulging in your new, false bonds?!

spans.text: You traitor! Why are you even mentioning them now when you're indulging in your new, false bonds?!

units.rawText: You don't deserve to speak their names, <cmdr>!
units.displayText: You don't deserve to speak their names, {교수}!

spans.text: You don't deserve to speak their names,

units.rawText: I'd never faced you like this in a one-on-one fight before. For one, you were never good at physical combat, and so when we had our differences, I never used force to make you yield.
units.displayText: I'd never faced you like this in a one-on-one fight before. For one, you were never good at physical combat, and so when we had our differences, I never used force to make you yield.

spans.text: I'd never faced you like this in a one-on-one fight before. For one, you were never good at physical combat, and so when we had our differences, I never used force to make you yield.

units.rawText: For another, I respected you as a comrade. I respected the hundreds, the thousands of battles you fought by my side, how your advice was like a ray of light that granted me new insights...
units.displayText: For another, I respected you as a comrade. I respected the hundreds, the thousands of battles you fought by my side, how your advice was like a ray of light that granted me new insights...

spans.text: For another, I respected you as a comrade. I respected the hundreds, the thousands of battles you fought by my side, how your advice was like a ray of light that granted me new insights...

units.rawText: And now, you are my opponent, my enemy, my greatest stumbling block on my road to revenge.
units.displayText: And now, you are my opponent, my enemy, my greatest stumbling block on my road to revenge.

spans.text: And now, you are my opponent, my enemy, my greatest stumbling block on my road to revenge.

units.rawText: Eosphorus suddenly intensifies his exertions and forces his sword against my chest. His eyes are bloodshot with wrath.
units.displayText: Eosphorus suddenly intensifies his exertions and forces his sword against my chest. His eyes are bloodshot with wrath.

spans.text: Eosphorus suddenly intensifies his exertions and forces his sword against my chest. His eyes are bloodshot with wrath.

units.displayText: It... can't be...

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus, are you no longer able to tell reality from fantasy?
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus, are you no longer able to tell reality from fantasy?

spans.text: ...Eosphorus, are you no longer able to tell reality from fantasy?

units.rawText: You're all nothing but illusions; you have no right to lecture me.

units.rawText: I am the Greater Sanctifier Eos of the Reverse Tower. I have been a Sanctifier from birth, through life, and in death.

spans.text: I am the Greater Sanctifier Eos of the Reverse Tower. I have been a Sanctifier from birth, through life, and in death.

units.rawText: This is my pride, my burden, and also my identity which I cannot and will not discard.
units.displayText: This is my pride, my burden, and also my identity which I cannot and will not discard.

spans.text: This is my pride, my burden, and also my identity which I cannot and will not discard.

units.rawText: I will help you convert the earring's data into an agent. She will be the Eos who traveled with you through the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: I will help you convert the earring's data into an agent. She will be the Eos who traveled with you through the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: I will help you convert the earring's data into an agent. She will be the Eos who traveled with you through the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: She will have a brand-new identity. Her place of origin will not be the Reverse Tower, but the Oasis, a newborn of Magrasea.
units.displayText: She will have a brand-new identity. Her place of origin will not be the Reverse Tower, but the Oasis, a newborn of Magrasea.

units.rawText: As for me, the Greater Sanctifier Eos' story came to an end when she activated Judgement Mode. What has remained until now is nothing more than a lost soul haunting Magrasea with a purpose burning in its heart.
units.displayText: As for me, the Greater Sanctifier Eos' story came to an end when she activated Judgement Mode. What has remained until now is nothing more than a lost soul haunting Magrasea with a purpose burning in its heart.

units.rawText: Hope is the right and responsibility of the newly born, while the dead should neither make requests nor have requests made of them. I finished everything I had to do on that day.

units.displayText: ...SHUT UP!

units.displayText: The king of Magrasea glares at them.

units.displayText: ...Why are you rejecting me? Why are you standing with them?!

them

units.rawText: Because I don't want to see you make any more mistakes.
units.displayText: Because I don't want to see you make any more mistakes.

spans.text: Because I don't want to see you make any more mistakes.

units.rawText: And I definitely don't want to see you drown in the mistakes of the past, sacrificing Magrasea as the price to get us back.
units.displayText: And I definitely don't want to see you drown in the mistakes of the past, sacrificing Magrasea as the price to get us back.

spans.text: ...But why is that wrong? Are you really willing to accept such a tragic end?

units.rawText: Yes. We do not regret following you, and we do not regret our choices and our deaths.
units.displayText: Yes. We do not regret following you, and we do not regret our choices and our deaths.

spans.text: Yes. We do not regret following you, and we do not regret our choices and our deaths.

units.rawText: ...I don't want peace! All I want is to save you from that day!

want
peace! All I want is to save you from that day!

units.rawText: Dying in battle against Electra was not a nightmare for me, Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Dying in battle against Electra was not a nightmare for me, Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: Dying in battle against Electra was not a nightmare for me, Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: It was a tragic end, yes. But to deny it would also be to deny the pride and glory that Electra and I had.
units.displayText: It was a tragic end, yes. But to deny it would also be to deny the pride and glory that Electra and I had.

spans.text: It was a tragic end, yes. But to deny it would also be to deny the pride and glory that Electra and I had.

units.rawText: I do not want my—our past with you to become something that causes you pain.
units.displayText: I do not want my—our past with you to become something that causes you pain.

spans.text: I do not want my—our past with you to become something that causes you pain.

units.rawText: Then just let me take it back! As long as I do, there won't be any more pain!
units.displayText: Then just let me take it back! As long as I do, there won't be any more pain!

spans.text: Then just let me take it back! As long as I do, there won't be any more pain!

units.displayText: So please... stand with me.

units.displayText: He holds his hand out to them, desperately pleading for his friends' acceptance.

spans.text: He holds his hand out to them, desperately pleading for his friends' acceptance.

spans.text: I will atone for the mistakes I have made. I will return time to that day and make a fresh start.

units.displayText: ...So stand with me!

units.displayText: Atlas simply shakes his head in response to Eosphorus' hysterics.

spans.text: I'm sorry, but I've gotta say no.

units.rawText: So we will personally free you of your burden.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.displayText: Eosphorus soon realizes what is happening and he immediately reaches out to try and stop them, but the boulder above him crushes down without pity. The only thing his hands manage to touch is the dust of days past.

spans.text: Eosphorus soon realizes what is happening and he immediately reaches out to try and stop them, but the boulder above him crushes down without pity. The only thing his hands manage to touch is the dust of days past.

units.rawText: Our existence has forced you to bear a burden you should not have had to carry, and because of us, the righteous leader of the Sanctifiers has drowned in his past and cannot move on.
units.displayText: Our existence has forced you to bear a burden you should not have had to carry, and because of us, the righteous leader of the Sanctifiers has drowned in his past and cannot move on.

spans.text: Our existence has forced you to bear a burden you should not have had to carry, and because of us, the righteous leader of the Sanctifiers has drowned in his past and cannot move on.

spans.text: Stop! I will not allow you to destroy your own neural clouds!

units.rawText: Hatred has clouded your eyes and left you unable to tell where the future leads.
units.displayText: Hatred has clouded your eyes and left you unable to tell where the future leads.

spans.text: Hatred has clouded your eyes and left you unable to tell where the future leads.

spans.text: Your obsession has made you forget your solemn duty and fall into the depths of chaos.

units.rawText: So please... Forget us, and forget the past.

units.displayText: Goodbye, Lord Eosphorus.
